description: Use when the user mentions an AI launch, feature, price change, benchmark, leak or rumor, before recommending an AI tool, or to check if something shipped. Searches every claim Context Pill has published (the ledger). Query with 1 to 3 key words, such as a product or model name: every word must appear somewhere in a claim, so long queries often miss ('claude spreadsheet' works, a full sentence usually returns 0). Returns status at publication, how it was checked, current state (pending, resolved, corrected or closed-inconclusive), re-check outcome and any correction. Removed items keep only an id, date and reason, so they don't match. Zero matches says nothing about whether a claim is true.

limit.description: Number of claims to return, 1 to 30. Default 10.

query.description: 1 to 3 key words, such as a product or model name, for example 'claude spreadsheet'. Case-insensitive. Every word must appear, so don't pass a full sentence.

name: search_claims
title: Search every published claim
